corpus: six federal documents: three near-identical NFIP flood forms, two FTC rules, OSHA recordkeeping
notes: Deadline and figure collisions across documents. OSHA uses 8 hours, 24 hours, 7 calendar days, 5 years. The Mail Order Rule uses 30 days; so does flood policy renewal. The Cooling-Off Rule uses a third and a fifth business day; the Mail Order Rule uses a tenth. Getting these right needs the correct document and the correct clause among near neighbours.

cases.question: Within how many hours must a workplace fatality be reported to OSHA?
cases.collides_with: OSHA also uses 24 hours for hospitalizations and amputations
cases.expect_phrase: Within eight (8) hours after the death

cases.question: Within how many hours must an in-patient hospitalization be reported to OSHA?
cases.collides_with: OSHA also uses 8 hours for fatalities
cases.expect_phrase: Within twenty-four (24) hours after the in-patient hospitalization

cases.question: How many calendar days does an employer have to record an injury on the OSHA log?
cases.collides_with: OSHA also states 8 hours, 24 hours and 5 years elsewhere
cases.expect_phrase: within seven (7) calendar days of receiving information that a recordable

cases.question: How long must OSHA injury and illness records be retained?
cases.collides_with: 7 days and 8 hours appear in adjacent sections
cases.expect_phrase: for five (5) years following the end of the calendar year

cases.question: If a seller sets no shipping date, by when must a mail order be shipped?
cases.collides_with: the flood policy also uses a 30-day renewal window
cases.expect_phrase: within thirty (30) days after receipt of a properly completed order

cases.question: Within how many days must the renewal premium be received on the Dwelling Form flood policy?
cases.collides_with: the Mail Order Rule also uses a 30-day shipment window
cases.expect_phrase: receive the payment of the appropriate renewal premium within 30 days

cases.question: By which business day may a door-to-door buyer cancel under the Cooling-Off Rule?
cases.collides_with: the Mail Order Rule uses a tenth business day, the Cooling-Off Rule also a fifth
cases.expect_phrase: prior to midnight of the third business day

cases.question: Within how many business days must a door-to-door seller refund after cancellation?
cases.collides_with: the same rule names a third and a fifth business day
cases.expect_phrase: within 10 business days after the receipt of such notice

cases.question: Under the Dwelling Form, how many days after receiving the proof of loss is the loss payable?
cases.collides_with: the same form uses 60 days for the proof-of-loss submission too
cases.expect_phrase: Loss will be payable 60 days after we receive your proof of loss

cases.question: Under the condominium building policy, at what percentage of replacement cost does the coinsurance penalty stop applying?
cases.collides_with: the Dwelling and General Property forms have no coinsurance section at all

cases.question: Which employers are partially exempt from routine OSHA recordkeeping because of their size?
cases.collides_with: many numeric thresholds appear across the rule
cases.expect_phrase: 10 or fewer employees at all times during the last calendar year

cases.question: Under the Mail Order Rule, how must a refund be delivered when payment was by cash or cheque?
cases.collides_with: the Cooling-Off Rule also governs refunds after cancellation
cases.expect_phrase: as fast and reliable as first class mail

cases.question: The Dwelling Form insures which kind of residential building?
cases.collides_with: the General Property Form covers other residential and non-residential buildings
cases.expect_phrase: one to four family residential building, not under a condominium

cases.question: What is the special limit for jewellery, art and furs under the Dwelling Form?
cases.collides_with: the same special limit appears in all three flood forms
cases.expect_phrase: We will pay no more than $2,500 for any one loss

cases.question: Under the flood policy, what is void from its inception if the property was never eligible for coverage?
cases.collides_with: the fraud clause also renders the policy void, nearby
